scope: Measurement only. Execution, record mode, native job production and Word16 Ethereum capture (plan mode) on the pinned round-five complete block. No proof produced, no source edits.

native_job_production.note: execution + 48B tape + RAM boundary capture + RAM openings/frontier + fsynced packet writes. Total packet bytes match the reference jobs exactly; packet digests differ because the request identity covers the output directory (not investigated further).

capture_plan_mode.note: capture_ns covers image load, program setup and the serial packet loop (main.zig timer). The first run started with a warmer/colder page cache than later runs. Prior receipts on the same block at 259f49ff8: 8.80-9.21 s (optimization-current-baseline-v1.json).

capture_profile.method: /usr/bin/sample at 1 ms on one plan run (12 s window, sampler overhead included); main-thread samples attributed by the nearest named frame
capture_profile.worker_threads: idle (futex wait) for the whole capture

packet_read_digest_admission_decode.detail: SHA-256 content digest over the packet, ROM admission walk (decode.effects 275), file read syscalls 285, tape decode/memmove ~300

cpu_replay_and_fact_routing.detail: Prepared.captureInternal + CPU.Source.capture: tape restore/validate, metadata, ROM counts, fact routing; BINARY dedup hash map ~380, wyhash ~170, decode.effects ~205, memmove ~185, ShiftFact appends ~45

ram_and_service_ledger.detail: collector.get / State hash map getOrPut ~290, LS validate ~120, image word rights ~45, inlined collector.one

comparison_public_claims_unverified.zkDTVM: claimed static binary translation RV32 to x86-64, ~3 GHz execute, ~700 MHz record mode producing GPU-native records (as briefed; not reproduced here)
comparison_public_claims_unverified.ZisK: x86-64 AOT assembly emulator; minimal trace per 2^18-step chunk (core/src/zisk_definitions.rs CHUNK_SIZE_BITS=18); source prints runtime MHz but states no figure
